notes.title: 0731 update
notes.notes:
newly added:
1. Full screen mode (can switch windows or full screen in battle mode)
2. You can now purchase net gun in the shopping mall
Adjusted content:
Right click to quickly exit the construction interface
Fix:
Bug in snow money and power display color occlusion

notes.title: 0723 update
notes.notes:
New content:
1. Add a new item, the Thunder Staff, which has a chance to be unlocked in the blind box after defeating the pink clothed magical woman. (Improve capture judgment blood line)
2. Added item fortifiers that can be obtained by defeating opponents, and some items can be strengthened in the base.(Old players will be compensated with a certain amount of fortifier based on the existing bounty)
Adjusted content:
1. Change the leaderboard to display the avatar of the protagonist
other:
Fixed bug where HDVD does not display images during construction
Fixed the bug of not deducting quantity when building ATM machines

notes.title: [0721]update
notes.notes:
New content:
1. Now you can carry the captured girl to battle and receive a buff that increases the speed of gold coin production
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079425/2af26da75e297b64beb7b32b948b18645e91531d.png[/img]
2. Add two new props that can be obtained by defeating the bosses in the second and third levels. Players who have already defeated the bosses will immediately receive the props.
Adjusted content:
1. Increase the explosion rate per level
The appearance of bosses is no longer random, but a fixed order.
other:
Fix known bugs.
Bug submission, please send to email 1399987519@qq.com
